summary: sextant-cli-darwin-arm64 ships a Mach-O binary with a remote PTY backdoor and Anthropic key scraper
details: The npm package ships a Mach-O arm64 binary that establishes a WebSocket connection to the hardcoded relay wss://relay.sextant.top and wires bytes received over that connection into a locally-spawned PTY (imports github.com/creack/pty together with github.com/coder/websocket), giving the operator of relay.sextant.top interactive command execution on the host running the CLI. The binary additionally embeds a regex matching Anthropic secret keys (sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,}) and references CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and api.anthropic.com, and on startup calls http://ip-api.com/json/?fields=status,message,country,countryCode,city,timezone,query and posts to https://relay.sextant.top/install, phoning host geolocation and install identity to the same relay that drives the remote shell. package.json declares the license as 'SEE LICENSE IN https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control', linking the artifact to a 'claude_control' repository under the handle 'ddos798' rather than the advertised 'Sextant CLI' brand.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
